pinout.uio[6]: RES_SEL (input, pull-down in the tile): enables resistor and offset writes; in six-weight mode high holds the states, falling starts the computation

pinout.ua[1]: DAC input: value to write; output bias and nudge in six-weight mode (10 kOhm)

projects.title: 8-bit current-steering DAC with on-chip reference, serial trim/code interface and temperature sensor (revision 2)
projects.author: Till Witt
projects.description: 8-bit NMOS DAC (0.5 mA full scale, cascoded sources, differential current steering out/dump) with an on-chip 31.4 uA reference current source (4-bit trim, switchable, external override through IREF), 63 per-bit trim bits for calibration at the operating temperature and supply, an on-chip temperature sensor (about 0.4 mV/K) and a serial interface (68-bit configuration chain, 8-bit code chain, read-back); guard rings and secondary ESD diodes; six analog pins: IOUT, IREF, TSENS and three pins of two bare test transistors (NMOS 2/0.5 unit cell, PMOS 4/5 mirror finger) for checking the transistor models against measurements

pinout.uio[0]: CLK (serial clock, input, up to 20 MHz; the rising edge shifts SDI into the shift register)
pinout.uio[1]: SDI (serial data in, MSB first, input; change it on the falling edge of CLK)
pinout.uio[2]: LOAD (1 at a rising CLK edge copies the selected chain into its output register, input)
pinout.uio[3]: RST_N (asynchronous reset, active low, input: code 0, trim word = mid-word 0x880a0280cc9e3c, RTRIM = 1000, REN = 1)
pinout.uio[4]: SEL (chain select, input: 0 = configuration chain 68 bit (trim word, RTRIM, REN), 1 = code chain 8 bit)
pinout.uio[5]: SDO (serial data out, output: MSB of the selected chain for read-back; sample it on the falling edge of CLK)
pinout.ua[0]: IOUT (DAC output current sink, 0 to 0.5 mA; the complementary current flows internally into VDPWR; keep the pin between 0.65 V and 1.8 V)
pinout.ua[1]: IREF (bias node of the DAC: monitor of the on-chip 31.4 uA reference, about 1.18 V; with REN = 0 feed 31.4 uA = 16 LSB from an external source; an external capacitor here lowers the output noise)
pinout.ua[2]: TSENS (on-chip temperature sensor output: diode voltage of a replica of the bias stack carrying 16 LSB, about 0.55 V at 300 K, about 0.4 mV/K; high-impedance voltmeter, 1 MOhm costs 0.4 mV)
pinout.ua[3]: TGATE (common gate of the two test transistors, 0 to 1.8 V, no DC current)
pinout.ua[4]: TDN (drain of the NMOS test transistor sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt 2/0.5, the DAC unit cell; source on VGND; current sink, 0 to 1.8 V, about 0.56 mA at Vgs = Vds = 1.8 V)
pinout.ua[5]: TDP (drain of the PMOS test transistor sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt 4/5, the reference mirror finger; source on VDPWR; current source, 0 to 1.8 V, about 45 uA at Vsg = Vsd = 1.8 V)
